metrics.method: Full history read end to end (1,698 rows, 2025-09-16 to 2026-08-26; 961 of them hers). client_questions_total = her messages containing '?'. unanswered_over_24h = questions where no ALTR message addressed the substance within 24h, counted on manual read rather than by next-message-timestamp (the chat is high-traffic, so a reply within 24h is common while the answer is not). Longest examples: leaks-still-running (2025-12-18, answered ~10 weeks later), the missing content snare link (2025-12-02, 13 days and two re-asks), the OFTV feature question (2026-06-26, 20 days and only after she re-asked), 'insta jail' (2025-10-08, ~8 days), OFTV next steps (2026-02-06, 4.6 days, answered 'just now seeing this'), where to drop the customs (2026-07-20, 5 days and 3 nudges), the earnings drop (2026-08-08, 45h and still no plan). Her Australian GST question (2026-01-02) was never answered at all. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive ALTR messages of any kind (2026-03-19 to 2026-03-28); excluding automated leak-removal posts the most damaging stretch was the 7 days of no human contact from 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-21 during the missed invoice cycle. Promises = explicit our-side commitments ('I'll send / get back to you / keep you posted / tomorrow / will update soon') counted manually; lapsed = no delivery visible in chat within a week or ever - e.g. weekly DMCA updates, the rescheduled WA content day, the Miami collab list (promised 2025-09-26 and again 2026-05-07), the Bali videographer, the Fansly answer, the link.me Safari fix, the OFTV live-stream coaching, the Phone Farm updates, the Aug 14 'tomorrow' invoice, the Aug 23 'give me a sec I'll fix', and the Aug 9 main-IG update.
